notes.title: Mini game Introduction and Demo Page is available now
notes.content:
A new Mini Game Introduction Video for Storm Cleaner is out on the front page. Check it out.

Also a free demo page is available at https://store.steampowered.com/app/3181310/.

We hope everyone find it easier to understand the game better.

notes.title: Open Playtest
notes.content:
To help the game become more engaging to the players, we would like to open the free playtest for all players. Check out the game and tell us the game you want.

2 new maps to explore every week !
